dingtalk.label: DingTalk
dingtalk.description: Reads your conversations, documents and meeting notes as you, and drafts replies.

steps.openBrowser: Click “Authorize” — the app opens your browser at the DingTalk sign-in page
steps.scanQr: Scan with the DingTalk mobile app to sign in to your account and organization
steps.confirmScope: After sign-in, review and confirm the recommended read permissions on the DWS authorization page
steps.backToApp: Once the browser confirms success, come back — the status refreshes on its own

feishu.label: Lark
feishu.description: Read-only access to Lark messages and Drive docs for the local graph and Q&A.

steps.openBrowser: Click Authorize to open the official Lark CLI authorization page
steps.confirm: Approve message search, message read, reaction read and Drive search
steps.backToApp: Return to the app; Lark content will enter the local database and knowledge graph

actions.useCodeHint: If the browser cannot open, finish on another device with a code
actions.refreshAvatarHint: Re-fetch your avatar from the platform — use it after changing your avatar there (the cached image never expires on its own).
actions.signOutHint: Clear only the credentials; the bound app stays. Your data stays too — hit Re-authorize to resume.
actions.switchUserHint: Revoke the current credentials and keep the app binding — a different account can sign in next time.
actions.switchAppHint: Also release the app binding — next authorization requires picking an app and signing in again. Use only when the app itself must change.
actions.signOutFailed: Could not clear credentials — there may have been no session
actions.switchAccountDone: Credentials and app binding cleared; hit Start to authorize another account
actions.switchUserDone: Signed out. Hit Start to sign in as someone else.
actions.switchAppDone: App binding cleared. Hit Start to pick an app and sign in.

twoStep.sessionMissing: Not done — hit Start to sign in

scope.readDescription: Reads conversations, contacts, documents and meeting notes as you, for distillation and search.
scope.noSpeakDescription: Generated replies go to drafts — nothing is sent until you confirm it.
scope.credentialsDescription: The official DingTalk CLI handles authorization; credentials live in your system keychain and are never uploaded.

dwsSource.title: Use your own dws
dwsSource.description: The app ships with a DingTalk CLI (dws). If you have another build installed, point to its absolute path here; leave empty to use the bundled one.
dwsSource.clear: Switch back to the bundled one
dwsSource.missing: That file can no longer be found; the bundled one is in use. Enter a new path or clear this field.
dwsSource.channelDescription: If your organization restricts CLI access to specific channels, enter the channel code from your distributor. Usually not needed.
dwsSource.channelInactive: Saved, but the bundled dws is in use, so it is not active right now.
dwsSource.channelFromEnv: The current channel code comes from an environment variable or .env.
dwsSource.fromEnv: Currently set by an environment variable: {{path}} (entering a path above overrides it)

account.adoptableHint: This DingTalk session already exists on this computer ({{corp}} · {{name}}) — sessions are shared across logins on the same machine. The current account isn't using it yet.

onboarding.machineSessionHint: This computer already has a DingTalk session (sessions are shared across logins on the same machine). Authorize once for the current account so we know who you are — otherwise learning would use the wrong identity.
onboarding.machineSessionHintFeishu: Lark is authorized in this app. Confirm the identity once for this account so learning attributes messages to you.

settings.expiredHint: Authorization expired — you'll need to scan again
settings.expiryWarning: This authorization expires in {{days}} days. Re-authorizing now is a good idea.
settings.identityMismatch: Identity misconfigured: this data is bound to "{{boundCorp}}", but the channel config directory currently resolves to "{{channelCorp}}". These should always match (each identity keeps its own data and config) — re-authorize to "{{boundCorp}}" to restore it, or switch to "{{channelCorp}}" and its own data.
settings.sharedCredentialNote: The official DingTalk CLI stores credentials in your system keychain, shared with the CLI in your terminal. To clear them completely, run <1>{{command}}</1> in a terminal.
settings.feishuCredentialNote: Lark credentials are isolated inside this app's user directory and do not reuse your terminal CLI session. To clear them, run <1>{{command}}</1> in the app's isolated environment.

progress.browserOpened: {{channel}} sign-in opened — scan the code to continue
progress.enterCode: Enter the code in your browser to finish {{channel}} authorization
progress.scopeAuthorization: Signed in — confirm the {{channel}} authorization scope in the newly opened page
progress.manualUrl: Browser didn't open? Visit this URL: {{url}}

feishuScope.readDescription: Read-only search of accessible Lark messages and Drive documents for the local database, graph and Q&A.
feishuScope.noSpeakDescription: Lark data never enters the auto-reply or send path, and no write scopes are requested.
feishuScope.credentialsDescription: The official Lark CLI handles authorization; credentials stay inside this app's isolated user directory.

avatarMiss.notPermitted: This channel client lacks contacts permission, so avatars cannot be fetched — switch to a client that has it under "custom client" below.
avatarMiss.notSet: This account has no avatar set on the platform.
avatarMiss.notReachable: The platform will not return this account’s avatar (no readable shared group).
avatarMiss.failed: Could not fetch it this time; try again later.
